name: Proto-Sino-Tibetan (family node)
notes: STRUCTURAL ANCESTRY NODE (not a modelled G2P target). Proto-Sino-Tibetan is the reconstructed common ancestor of the Sino-Tibetan (Trans-Himalayan) family, including Sinitic, Bodish (Tibetan) and Lolo-Burmese (Burmese). It exists so that the ancestry and phylogenetic-distance metrics of the modern varieties that reference it have a node to resolve to. It carries no grapheme table: the ancestry metrics use only its classification and its ancestor links. A grapheme table needs a cited reconstruction that states its notation and the sound value of each symbol.
